facebook.caption:
POV: you walk past a dozen tourist cafés on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo and then find Tarapaca Cafe.

4.7 stars. 732 reviews. Under $10 a person.

The kind of place you order a second coffee just to stay longer. No hustle, no upsell, just a solid cup and a good seat.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
